sonnet.problem: This card tells Thomas saying he will go and die with Jesus, and then jokes about needing a pep talk to walk past an oven. Verse 16 is about death, so it is a heavy moment and should carry no joke. The card also repeats the answer the baker just gave on card 12.
sonnet.rule: A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke.

sonnet.problem: The card runs to three sentences: the quoted line, the Thomas sentence ending in "two names?", and the "I respect it" sentence. A non-opening story card may have only 1 to 2 sentences.
sonnet.rule: Every other story card, including the first card of a later stop, is 1 to 2 sentences.
